allowed_ips.title: Allowed IPs
allowed_ips.hint: Trusted IPv4/IPv6 addresses and networks. These entries win over exact bans, blocked networks, and default-deny mode. IPv4/IPv6 wildcards like 192.168.1.* or 2001:db8:1:2:* are supported.
allowed_ips.remove_confirm: Remove this Allowed IP? With default-deny or blocked networks active, removing a trusted entry can lock out access.

blocked_ips.title: Blocked IPs
blocked_ips.hint: Home Assistant's native exact IPv4/IPv6 block list, written oldest first in ip_bans.yaml.

blocked_networks.title: Blocked Networks
blocked_networks.hint: Managed IPv4/IPv6 CIDR or wildcard networks, enforced without writing ranges into ip_bans.yaml.

settings.ban_notifications_enabled_hint: Show alerts when IPs are blocked.
settings.geoip_enabled_hint: Show approximate public-IP locations. If the local database is missing, Apply downloads it.
settings.allowlisted_logins_can_ban_hint: Be careful: trusted IPs can be blocked.
settings.default_deny_enabled_hint: Be careful: only Allowed IPs can connect.

backup.restore_confirm: Restore from the on-disk backup and replace current IP Ban Manager settings and exact IP bans?
backup.transfer_hint: Download a copy to this device, or upload a backup to restore.
backup.upload_confirm: Upload {filename} and replace current IP Ban Manager settings and exact IP bans?

geoip.title: GeoIP database
geoip.download_hint: Enable GeoIP and Apply to download

issues.ban_file_not_loaded: Home Assistant IP banning is not loaded.
issues.panel_not_registered: The IP Ban Manager panel is not registered.
